summary: TerrAscend Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a private placement of secured convertible debentures, issuing 21,702 units at US$1,000 each for US$21.7 million in gross proceeds. The filing details the terms: 8% annual cash interest (or PIK at 9-10%), maturity September 30, 2031, conversion price US$0.87 per share, secured by a second lien on U.S. assets. Proceeds were used to retire existing convertible debentures (US$11.1M) and for M&A/debt refinancing. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
